ios.desc:
Roomli is one app for shared home life.

Whether you live with a partner, roommates, or family, Roomli keeps
shopping, chores, bills, and everyday household tasks in one shared
place — so you stop forgetting what the house needs and stop arguing
about who did what.

Designed for:
- Couples splitting groceries and chores
- Roommates sharing bills and cleaning
- Families coordinating routines and reminders

What you can do with Roomli:
- Shared shopping lists that sync in real time
- Chores and tasks with who-did-what history
- Bill reminders and shared expense tracking
- Household routines and recurring items
- Simple household setup with an invite link

Free to use, with optional premium for advanced features like
extended history, unlimited households, and custom themes.

Stop the chaos. Share the home.
